cli.help.anyFolder: Run from any folder: node <path-to-repo>/scripts/tilda.mjs --site <site folder> …; the .env in the repository root is not read. The template catalog is TILDA_CATALOG_DIR (shared by all sites).
cli.help.cmd.browser: browser start|stop|status|show|hide — browser holder (commands start it themselves by default); show — put the window on screen, hide — minimize it; --donor — donor holder (profile TILDA_DONOR_BROWSER_PROFILE)
cli.help.cmd.catalog: catalog capture|list — reference fields of templates: capture on a draft page (--page --slug|--tplid) or show what was captured
cli.help.cmd.catalogCalibrate: catalog calibrate --page <draft> --slug|--tplid [--force] [--delay ms] [--batch n] [--pause s]  map "setting value → markup" by preview (a temporary block is created and deleted)
cli.help.cmd.doctor: doctor [--site <folder>] [--json] — check Node.js, dependencies, Chrome, git, the site folder, .env and the skill; only checks and prints fix commands
cli.help.cmd.donor: donor pages|map|copy|style|verify|aliases|links — transfer through the donor account: list of donor pages under its sign-in, map of labels ↔ donor pages (--slug), copying a page through the buffer, donor font and styling, comparison, page addresses of the copy, rewriting donor links
cli.help.cmd.donorAliases: donor aliases --slug <snapshot> [--dry-run]  page addresses of the copy same as donor pages (files donor pages and page list; header, footer and home page are skipped, a taken address is not taken away)
cli.help.cmd.donorCheck: donor check --slug <snapshot> [--source P01,P02]  checks after the transfer by labels: links (donor domain, relative addresses, donor pages by ID), HTML blocks, formmsgurl, map completeness, home page; the result is a summary section
cli.help.cmd.donorCopy: donor copy --slug <snapshot> --source <label> | --from <donor pageid> --to <pageid> [--replace] [--dry-run]  move the blocks of a donor page to the target through the donor account buffer (an action under the donor sign-in — only on the owner's explicit "go")
cli.help.cmd.donorLinks: donor links --slug <snapshot> --source <label> [--dry-run]  donor links (domain, /page<donor ID>.html, including *.tilda.ws) → paths to pages of the copy (only the link address; form fields are not changed; snapshot before, verify after)
cli.help.cmd.donorMap: donor map --slug <snapshot>  site map labels ↔ donor pages by addresses and roles (site.json: donorPageid); no network; run donor pages first
cli.help.cmd.donorStyle: donor style --slug <snapshot> [--apply --confirm]  donor styling and own font → donor-style.json; with --apply --confirm — into the test project (font as links to donor files, colors and weights through the form, rollback record as in reference project)
cli.help.cmd.donorVerify: donor verify --slug <snapshot> --source <label> [--width 1440,320]  block composition against the snapshot, markup comparison, frames of the build and the reference, report reports/<label>.transfer.md
cli.help.cmd.page: page duplicate|create|publish|delete|list|role|title — duplicate, empty page, publish (--page <id> --confirm), delete instructions, list of project pages, header, footer and home page of the project, page title
cli.help.cmd.pageRoleFlags: --header <id|none> --footer <id|none>  page role: header page and footer page of the project (only with --confirm)
cli.help.cmd.pageRoleIndex: page role --index <pageid> --confirm  home page of the project (set separately from header and footer; protected pages are refused)
cli.help.cmd.pageTitle: page title --page <id> --title <text>  page title in the dashboard (page settings window; protected pages are refused before any request)
cli.help.cmd.reference: reference fetch|structure|pages|plan|shot|audit — snapshot of a reference site through the holder, page structure, site map, build plan (--url --slug; plan: --source --page <draft>), screenshot and link check
cli.help.cmd.referenceAudit: reference audit --slug <snapshot> --source <label>  links of the built page: no reference domain, /page<id>.html is in page list
cli.help.cmd.referenceCompare: reference compare --slug <snapshot> --source <label> [--published --url <address>]  block-by-block markup comparison of the built page with the reference, report reports/<label>.auto.md
cli.help.cmd.referencePages: reference pages   site map: labels P00…, HDR, FTR ↔ snapshot pages and new pageids (site.json)
cli.help.cmd.referenceProject: reference project --slug <snapshot> [--apply --confirm]  fonts and colors of the reference project → settings of the test project (written only with --apply --confirm)
cli.help.cmd.referenceShot: reference shot --slug <snapshot> --source <label> [--width 1440,320]  screenshot of a reference page with the same mechanism as shot
cli.help.cmd.session: session --donor [--wait <sec>]  sign in to the donor account in its holder: the window is shown only while you sign in; the donor project is only read
cli.help.cmd.setup: setup [--site <folder>] [--project <ID>] [--agent claude|codex|all] [--lang en|ru] — create the site folder and .env from .env.example (an existing .env is not overwritten), install the tilda-manager skill into the agent folder inside the repository
cli.help.cmd.stage: stage '<json>' | stage --plan <file> | stage diff|apply|drop|list — cumulative plan of edits and its local diff
cli.help.exitCodes: Exit codes: 0 success, 1 mismatch/refusal, 2 arguments, 3 no session.
cli.help.flag.apply: --apply           reference project: write the styling into the test project settings (needs --confirm)
cli.help.flag.batchDelayPause: --batch/--delay/--pause  promote: pace of full snapshots — reads per batch (10), ms between reads (2500), s between batches and snapshots (60)
cli.help.flag.confirm: --confirm         page publish: explicit confirmation of publishing (without it — refusal before any request)
cli.help.flag.create: --create          reference pages: create the missing map pages in the project (empty, one by one, pause --delay ms, 3000)
cli.help.flag.delaySettle: --delay/--settle  reference fetch: ms between pages (2500) and wait after loading (1500)
cli.help.flag.donor: --donor           browser/session: holder and sign-in of the donor account (TILDA_DONOR_PROJECT_ID, TILDA_DONOR_BROWSER_PROFILE)
cli.help.flag.emitCalls: --emit-calls      apply: also write debug *.call.js files for browser_evaluate
cli.help.flag.follow: --follow          reference fetch: follow internal links of the same site
cli.help.flag.force: --force           catalog capture: capture already captured templates again
cli.help.flag.fromTo: --from/--to       promote: working copy and live page (both required)
cli.help.flag.images: --images          reference fetch: download block images into images/
cli.help.flag.lang: --lang en|ru      CLI message language (otherwise TILDA_LANG, then the system language, then English)
cli.help.flag.links: --links           shot: also check links and images
cli.help.flag.max: --max <n>         reference fetch: pages per run (20 by default); the rest of the queue is kept and taken by a repeated run
cli.help.flag.noOpen: --no-open         map: do not open the map in a viewer (opened by default)
cli.help.flag.noStyles: --no-styles       reference plan: do not transfer styling (margins, background, typography)
cli.help.flag.page: --page <pageid>   page (otherwise TILDA_DEFAULT_PAGE, if the command needs a page)
cli.help.flag.project: --project <ID>    setup: Tilda project ID for a new .env
cli.help.flag.published: --published       reference compare: compare the published page at --url (the address is given by the owner)
cli.help.flag.replace: --replace         donor copy: delete the target blocks after the snapshots and transfer again
cli.help.flag.site: --site <folder>   site folder outside the repository: .env, site-baseline, site-reference, .browser-profile, plans (or TILDA_SITE_DIR); without it, commands that use site data refuse with exit code 2
cli.help.flag.sitemap: --sitemap         reference fetch: add pages from the sitemap.xml of the same site to the queue
cli.help.flag.slug: --slug <name>     reference: snapshot name in TILDA_REFERENCE_DIR (Latin letters, digits, hyphen)
cli.help.flag.source: --source <name|label>  reference plan: snapshot page name or site map label (P07, HDR, FTR — page, zone and substitutes from site.json)
cli.help.flag.substitute: --substitute <a>=<b>  reference plan: build blocks of template a with template b (an unavailable menu 770 → an available menu template); can be repeated or comma-separated
cli.help.flag.tplid: --tplid <list>    catalog capture: templates separated by commas instead of --slug (for example 796,702); --delay — ms between references (2500)
cli.help.flag.unprotect: --unprotect       promote: lift the protection of the live page for this call (otherwise refusal at step 4)
cli.help.flag.update: --update          reference plan: complete an already built page of the label with field/listSet operations (without recreating blocks)
cli.help.flag.url: --url <address>   reference fetch: reference page the walk starts from
cli.help.flag.wait: --wait <sec>      session: how long to wait for the person to sign in (600 by default)
cli.help.flag.width: --width <list>    shot: widths separated by commas (1440,320 by default)
cli.help.flag.zone: --zone all|content|header|footer  reference plan by page name: build only the zone (by label — from site.json)
cli.help.rollback: rollback <record>   roll back by a journal record: node scripts/tilda.mjs --site <site folder> rollback <site folder>/site-baseline/journal/<pageid>/<file>.json
